€1P. (चिल्ल्लति, चिल्ल्लित) 
__1 To become loose, be slack or flaccid. 
__2 To act wantonly, sport.

चिलमी(मि)लिका
 
__1 A kind of necklace. 
__2 A fire-fly. 
__3 Lightning.

चिलि(ली)चि
(ची)मः, 
-मिः, चिलीमः, चेलचीमः A kind of fish. Charak advises that this fish should not be eaten with milk. (Mar. ‘वेगसा’ मासा.)

a. [चिल्ल-अच्] Blear-eyed. 
-ल्लः 
__1 A bleared or sored eye. 
__2 The (Bengal) kite; चिल्ला also in this sense; बन्धनभ्रष्टो गृहकपोतश्चिल्लाया मुखे पतितः [[

चिल्लका,
चिल्लिका, चिल्ली A cricket; cf. झिल्लिका.
